zh-CN.title: 前台语音通话
items: VIP 语音通话支持全屏和折叠，聊天中保留通话记录。
双方共用各自每周五分钟额度，拨打前检查可用时长。
通话提示改用模态框和 Toast，个性化聊天预览新增通话气泡。

en.title: Foreground voice calls
items: VIP voice calls support full-screen and minimized views, with a call record in chat.
Calls check both participants’ weekly five-minute allowances before dialing.
Call prompts use dialogs and Toast, with call bubbles included in chat appearance previews.
